{1: '1', 2: 'Logistics Captain', 3: 'Move it! Containers loaded before the last transport leaves, now!', 4: '1'}

{3: 'Outside the gates of New Sophiasburgh, over a dozen small trucks sit crookedly in the snow. Their cargo beds are only half-full, but no one dares pause for rest. Beside the vehicles, the Logistics Captain shouts orders, his voice already raw and hoarse.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Driver', 3: "Captain, this truck isn't filling up. Let me roll out now, and you start loading the next one.", 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Logistics Captain', 3: "You think I haven't tried hurrying them along? All our real fighters are at the front! You know who we've got left here.", 4: '2'}

{3: 'Chaos erupts. One man staggers under a box of compressed rations, another—breath clouding in the frigid air—drags a heavy medical kit through the snow. Then, a sharp cry cuts through the noise as he stumbles and falls.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Man B', 3: 'Hey, you okay there?', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Man A', 3: "I'm alright. Tripped over a damn brick.", 4: '2'}
{3: 'The man kneads his sore knee, and as the pain sparks into anger, he lashes out, sending the brick skittering away.'}
{2: 'Man A', 3: 'Who the hell left this thing right in the middle of the road?!', 4: '2'}
{3: 'The brick clangs against exposed rebar in a nearby foundation, scattering ice shards. The sound makes everyone pause.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1396.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.8'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1396.jpg'}
{3: 'Their gazes sweep across what they call a "city." Apart from the relatively impressive gate before them, the place is little more than a field of uneven, half-dug foundations.'}

{3: 'Rebar juts from the frozen earth like rusty bones. Building materials are piled in chaotic heaps. Further back, rows of cold-weather tents dot the ice plain, a sight no better than the shacks they once lived in while working on ships.'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1395.jpg', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.5'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1395.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Man A', 3: 'Whose bright idea was this? Build a fancy gate before putting up livable buildings?', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Man B', 3: "Quit whining. You voted for it, too, didn't you?", 4: '2'}
{3: "The man's protest dies in his throat. He had cast his vote for that very gate, believing in New Sophiasburgh's need for a dignified front."}
{3: 'Now, the irony was bitter. They have built a city, yet their daily reality is just as harsh. Basic supplies are scarce; a simple hot meal remains a luxury.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Logistics Captain', 3: 'Hey, you lot! Eyes on the job! No stopping. You know how bad it is up front!', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Man B', 3: "Yeah, yeah. We're moving.", 4: '2'}
{3: 'Urged on, the men cease their complaints, heft the supplies, and quickly rejoin the line.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Boy', 3: 'Evan, can you help me? This is too heavy...', 4: '1'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Evan', 3: 'Alright, we each take one side.', 4: '2'}
{3: 'To support the front lines, even children have joined the transport effort. Lifting their side of the package, Evan and his friends resume moving toward the trucks.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStory/FxUiStoryBlackPassScene.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1396.jpg'}
{3: 'Then, near the gate, they spot several men huddled in conversation at an alley entrance.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Civilian Guard A', 3: "The reports from the front lines... If that really is General Zack, wouldn't surrendering be the smart move?", 4: '1'}
{3: "Evan recognizes them as veteran Border Commune members who once fought on the front lines. Though now assigned to the Civilian Guard, they're far more obstinate than Antonov ever was."}
{2: 'Civilian Guard B', 3: "Have you lost it? He controls the Corrupted. He's an enemy of humanity.", 4: '2'}
{2: 'Civilian Guard A', 3: "If he were truly our enemy, wouldn't he have ordered a sneak attack on our rear already?", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Civilian Guard A', 3: "You know how thin we're spread. If General Zack—no, the Frostheart Emperor—really wanted us dead, this place would be rubble!", 4: '1'}
{2: 'Civilian Guard A', 3: "But look. For all the fighting, he's deliberately avoided hitting anything beyond the battlefield. Why? It's obvious.", 4: '1'}
{3: 'To realize the ideals of the Arctic Route Union, the Frostheart Emperor needs its people. This is the conclusion the men have reached.'}
{3: 'For those who remember the Sophiasburgh era and knew both the Frostheart Emperor and Zack personally, surrender has emerged as a viable alternative to the front lines.'}
{3: 'They are, after all, Union people, citizens of Sophiasburgh. So why fight against Zack? Why battle their own home?'}
{3: "If they simply surrendered, wouldn't the killing stop? Wouldn't the sacrifices end?"}
{1: '1', 2: 'Logistics Captain', 3: "What do you think you're doing? Civilian Guard doesn't mean slacking off! Get back to moving supplies, now!", 4: '1'}
{3: 'The three men blanch, hastily straighten their uniforms, and scurry from the alley like chastised dogs.'}

{1: '1', 3: "Yet their words linger behind, striking Evan's heart like thrown stones. A ripple of anxiety, a pang of hesitation, and a thread of inexplicable confusion settle within him, then seem to drift away with the wind across the snow-blanketed grounds of New Sophiasburgh."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Boy', 3: "Evan! Why'd you let go?!", 4: '2'}
{3: "The boy's shout jolts Evan back to reality. The package has slipped from his hands and hit the ground; the boy is now straining to lift it, his face pale with effort."}
{2: 'Evan', 3: "Sorry! I'm sorry!", 4: '1'}
{3: 'With a grunt, he lifts the package again. Yet the words linger, ice-sharp, scraping at his resolve from within.'}
